text: ボスが　おこる　まえに　かえって　ねた　ほうが　いいぞ

structure.jp: ボスが　おこる　まえに
ねた　ほうが　いいぞ

patterns.name: 〜たほうがいい
patterns.span: ねた　ほうが　いい
patterns.explanation: A past-form verb plus ほうが いい gives advice: 'you'd better do it'. ねた　ほうが　いい = 'you'd better go to bed'.

patterns.name: 〜まえに
patterns.explanation: まえに after a plain verb means 'before doing that'. ボスが　おこる　まえに = 'before the boss gets angry'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins two actions done one after the other. かえって　ねた = 'go home and go to bed'.
